en: Vintage illustrated postcard with a decorative coat of arms on the left, showing a shield with multiple blue lions and a crowned, robed female figure above it. A scroll-like banner beneath the shield bears a short greeting. To the right of the coat of arms is a panoramic view of a harbor city at sunset with sailing ships, steam boats, and a skyline of tall church spires and buildings along the waterfront. Ornamental scrollwork connects the coat of arms and the city vignette, leaving the lower right area blank for writing.
